C1187.title: CVE-2019-5736 runc Container Escape Vulnerability
C1187.summary: CVE-2019-5736 is one of the most impactful container escape vulnerabilities, existing in the runc runtime. A malicious container can obtain the host's runc binary path via /proc/self/exe and overwrite it, enabling arbitrary code execution on the host. Mitigation requires updating runc to version 1.0-rc6 or later, or adopting sandboxed runtimes such as gVisor.

references.title: Container Security Best Practices: Preventing Container Escape and Attacks - JianShu
